title: kbgit.py sync sends code-lane commits straight to main when backlog.json does not parse, since has_code_lane reads the defaults then and the default lane_module is empty
goal: kg_lane.has_code_lane keeps the code lane when backlog.json is unreadable, not valid JSON or gives lane_module a value that is no string, and answers False only for a readable file or a missing one whose lane_module is empty

run: import sys,os,tempfile,subprocess;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kg_lane;d=tempfile.mkdtemp();subprocess.run(['git','-C',d,'init','-q']);open(d+'/backlog.json','w').write('{"lane_module": "kblane"');r=kg_lane.has_code_lane(d);print('truncated backlog.json keeps the code lane:',r);sys.exit(0 if r else 1)
